text: Computer vision is the field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One key task is image recognition, where a system identifies what is in a photo, such as a cat or a tree. Another is object detection, which not only finds objects but also locates them with boxes. These technologies have many everyday applications, from unlocking phones with facial recognition to helping doctors analyze medical scans. Perhaps most impressively, computer vision powers self-driving cars, allowing them to spot pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles in real time. As this technology grows, it promises to change how we interact with machines and our environment.
